entries.title: Keep apply and build stages off dirty repositories
when: Tracked edits already exist before apply starts.
The repo cleanliness check blocks the operation.
do: Clean or isolate the worktree before rebuilding.
Preserve the current task artifacts and stop early.
avoid: Applying a new patch on top of unreviewed tracked edits.

entries.title: Rebuild or rebase a patch that no longer applies cleanly
when: A patch no longer matches the current tree.
git apply reports check failure or rejected hunks.
do: Recompute the diff against the current tree.
Confirm the task folder still matches the target branch.
Apply only after the patch has been regenerated or refreshed.
avoid: Retrying the same stale patch without refreshing it.
